<style>
:root{
  color-scheme:dark;
  --bg:#0a1416; --surface:#0e1d21; --raised:#12272c; --line:#1d4f58; --line-soft:#16393f;
  --accent:#22d3ee; --accent-hi:#67e8f9; --on-accent:#04161a;
  --text:#d8f8ff; --muted:#8bb5be; --danger:#fca5a5;
  --input:#081114; --line-hover:#2a6c78; --placeholder:#5f8790; --check1:#0b1a1e; --check2:#0f2328; --glow:#0f3a42; --card-min:250px; --prev-h:140px;
  --sans:"DM Sans",system-ui,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
  --display:"Sora","DM Sans",system-ui,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
  --mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(900px 420px at 90% -80px,var(--glow) 0,transparent 70%),var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:16px/1.55 var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
main{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:40px 20px 64px}
h1{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4.2vw,2.6rem);line-height:1.12;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0 0 8px}
.credit{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--accent-hi)}
.lede{margin:0;color:var(--muted);max-width:60ch}
.panel{margin-top:14px;padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface);display:grid;gap:12px}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.field{flex:1;min-width:200px;display:grid;gap:4px}
.field label{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
input,button{font:inherit;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--input);color:var(--text);padding:10px 12px;min-height:44px}
input::placeholder{color:var(--placeholder)}
input:hover{border-color:var(--line-hover)}
button{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s,transform .1s}
button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.primary{font-family:var(--display);background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);font-weight:800}
.primary:hover{background:var(--accent-hi);border-color:var(--accent-hi)}
.primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}
.row .primary{align-self:flex-end}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent-hi);outline-offset:2px}
.combo{position:relative}
.suggest{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(100% + 6px);z-index:10;margin:0;padding:6px;list-style:none;max-height:340px;overflow:auto;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.opt{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}
.opt[aria-selected="true"],.opt:hover{background:var(--raised)}
.opt .top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:baseline}
.opt .n{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.opt .m{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.opt .d{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:1;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.msg{padding:12px;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted)}
.msg.error{color:var(--danger)}
.ghost{background:var(--raised)}
.ghost:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--accent)}
.ghost:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
select{font:inherit;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--input);color:var(--text);padding:10px 12px;min-height:44px;width:100%}
select:hover{border-color:var(--line-hover)}
.check{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:.92rem;cursor:pointer}
.check input{min-height:0;width:18px;height:18px;padding:0;accent-color:var(--accent)}
.cloak-note{color:var(--accent-hi)!important}
.top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.opt-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:none}
body[data-pbg="dark"] .preview{background-image:none;background-color:var(--check1)}
body[data-pbg="light"] .preview{background-image:none;background-color:#f3f4f6}
body.no-previews .preview{display:none}
body.no-path .path{display:none}
dialog.drawer{margin:0 0 0 auto;padding:0;width:min(440px,100vw);height:100dvh;max-height:100dvh;border:0;border-left:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);flex-direction:column}
dialog.drawer[open]{display:flex;animation:slidein .2s ease-out}
dialog.drawer::backdrop{background:rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
@keyframes slidein{from{transform:translateX(24px);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.drawer-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft)}
.drawer-head h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.1rem;margin:0}
.drawer-body{overflow:auto;padding:2px 20px 28px}
.opt-sec{padding:18px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft);display:grid;gap:12px}
.opt-sec:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.opt-sec h3{margin:0;font-family:var(--display);font-size:.95rem}
.opt-sec p{margin:0;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}
.opt-sec .field{min-width:0}
.swatches{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.sw{width:32px;height:32px;min-height:0;padding:0;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid transparent}
.sw[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--text);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--surface) inset}
.inline{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:.92rem}
input[type="color"]{width:48px;height:36px;min-height:0;padding:2px;cursor:pointer}
.tip{margin:22px 0 0;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface);font-size:.92rem;color:var(--text)}
.tip strong{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;color:var(--accent-hi)}
.viewbar{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
.seg{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;padding:3px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface)}
.seg button{min-height:36px;padding:6px 12px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem}
.seg button:hover{color:var(--text)}
.seg button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);font-weight:700}
.sm{min-height:36px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:.88rem}
.group{margin-top:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface)}
.group>summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;border-radius:14px}
.group>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.group>summary::before{content:"›";color:var(--accent-hi);font-size:1.3rem;line-height:1;transition:transform .15s}
.group[open]>summary::before{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.gname{flex:1;font:600 .88rem/1.3 var(--mono);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.gcount{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.group .grid{margin:0;padding:0 14px 14px}
.crumbs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-top:14px;font-size:.92rem}
.crumbs button{min-height:32px;padding:4px 8px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--accent-hi);font-weight:600}
.crumbs button:hover{background:var(--raised)}
.crumbs .sep{color:var(--muted)}
.folders{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:14px}
.folder{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left;padding:14px;min-height:0;border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface)}
.folder:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.folder .ficon{color:var(--accent);display:flex;flex:none}
.folder .fname{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.folder .fcount{display:block;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted)}
.status{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:22px 2px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
.status.error{color:var(--danger)}
.status strong{color:var(--text)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(var(--card-min),1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:14px}
.item{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface);overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .15s}
.item:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.preview{height:var(--prev-h);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft);
  background-color:var(--check1);
  background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,var(--check2) 25%,transparent 25%,transparent 75%,var(--check2) 75%),linear-gradient(45deg,var(--check2) 25%,transparent 25%,transparent 75%,var(--check2) 75%);
  background-size:16px 16px;background-position:0 0,8px 8px}
.preview img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.preview .none{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}
.body{padding:14px 14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;flex:1}
.item h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.95rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.path{margin:2px 0 0;font:.78rem/1.4 var(--mono);color:var(--muted);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:auto}
.actions button,.actions a{min-height:38px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:.88rem}
.actions a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;color:var(--accent-hi);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600}
.actions a:hover{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--raised)}
.copy{background:var(--raised)}
.copy:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.copy.done{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent)}
.skeleton{height:268px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line-soft);background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--surface),var(--raised),var(--surface));background-size:200% 100%;animation:pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{from{background-position:200% 0}to{background-position:-200% 0}}
.empty{grid-column:1/-1;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:28px;color:var(--muted)}
.empty strong{display:block;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:4px}
footer{margin-top:36px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:75ch}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body><main>
<header class="top"><div>
  <h1>br4y’s epic and cool .svg checker</h1>
  <p class="credit">Credits: original page by OrangeesDev</p>
  <p class="lede">Scans a public GitHub repository and lists every SVG on its default branch, with previews and ready-to-copy jsDelivr links.</p>
</div><button id="openOptions" class="ghost opt-btn" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 6h9M18 6h3M3 12h3M12 12h9M3 18h11M20 18h1"></path><circle cx="15" cy="6" r="2"></circle><circle cx="9" cy="12" r="2"></circle><circle cx="17" cy="18" r="2"></circle></svg>Options</button></header>

<p class="tip"><strong>Tip:</strong> <span id="tipText">Got a unblocked JsDelivr site? Copy the repo and user to potentially get lots of links!</span></p>

<section class="panel" aria-label="Repository search">
  <div class="row">
    <div class="field combo">
      <label for="search">Search GitHub repositories</label>
      <input id="search" type="text" role="combobox" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="suggest" aria-autocomplete="list" placeholder="Search by name, or type owner/ to browse a user's repos" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
      <ul id="suggest" class="suggest" role="listbox" aria-label="Matching repositories" hidden=""></ul>
    </div>
    <button id="refresh" class="ghost" type="button" disabled="">Rescan</button>
  </div>
  <div class="field"><label for="filter">Filter SVGs by filename</label><input id="filter" placeholder="Type to filter…" autocomplete="off"></div>
</section>
<div id="status" class="status" role="status" aria-live="polite">Search for a repository to list its SVGs.</div>
<div class="viewbar">
  <div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Folder view">
    <button type="button" class="seg-btn" data-view="all" aria-pressed="true">All SVGs</button>
    <button type="button" class="seg-btn" data-view="grouped" aria-pressed="false">Grouped by folder</button>
    <button type="button" class="seg-btn" data-view="browse" aria-pressed="false">Browse folders</button>
  </div>
  <div id="groupTools" class="row" hidden=""><button type="button" id="expandAll" class="ghost sm">Expand all</button><button type="button" id="collapseAll" class="ghost sm">Collapse all</button></div>
</div>
<div id="results"></div>

<footer>Uses GitHub's public API, so no token is needed for public repositories. Private repositories and rate-limited requests will show an error. jsDelivr links point to the repository's current default branch.</footer>
</main>
<dialog id="options" class="drawer" aria-labelledby="optionsTitle">
  <div class="drawer-head"><h2 id="optionsTitle">Options</h2><button id="closeOptions" class="primary" type="button">Done</button></div>
  <div class="drawer-body">
    <section class="opt-sec"><h3>Appearance</h3>
      <div class="field"><label id="accentLbl">Accent color</label><div class="swatches" id="swatches" role="group" aria-labelledby="accentLbl"></div></div>
      <div class="inline"><label for="accentPicker">Custom color</label><input type="color" id="accentPicker"></div>
      <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="optTint"> Tint the backgrounds with the accent color</label>
      <div class="field"><label for="optDensity">Card size</label><select id="optDensity"><option value="small">Small</option><option value="medium">Medium</option><option value="large">Large</option></select></div>
    </section>
    <section class="opt-sec"><h3>Results</h3>
      <div class="field"><label for="optSort">Sort SVGs by</label><select id="optSort"><option value="path-asc">Path, A to Z</option><option value="path-desc">Path, Z to A</option><option value="name-asc">Filename, A to Z</option></select></div>
      <div class="field"><label for="optPreviewBg">Preview background</label><select id="optPreviewBg"><option value="checker">Checkerboard</option><option value="dark">Solid dark</option><option value="light">Solid light</option></select></div>
      <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="optShowPreviews"> Show previews</label>
      <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="optShowPath"> Show file paths</label>
    </section>
    <section class="opt-sec"><h3>Copy button</h3>
      <div class="field"><label for="optCopy">What it copies</label><select id="optCopy"><option value="jsdelivr">jsDelivr URL</option><option value="raw">GitHub raw URL</option><option value="markdown">Markdown image</option><option value="html">HTML <img> tag</option></select></div>
    </section>
    <section class="opt-sec"><h3>Search and startup</h3>
      <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="optAsType"> Search as I type</label>
      <p>When off, press Enter to search. This helps avoid GitHub's search rate limit.</p>
      <div class="field"><label for="optCount">Search results shown</label><select id="optCount"><option value="5">5</option><option value="8">8</option><option value="12">12</option><option value="20">20</option></select></div>
      <div class="field"><label for="optStart">Starting repository</label><input id="optStart" placeholder="owner/repository" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></div>
      <p>This repository is scanned every time the page opens. You can paste a GitHub link or type owner/repository.</p>
      <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="optRemember"> Open the last repository I viewed instead</label>
    </section>
    <section class="opt-sec"><h3>Tab cloak</h3>
      <p>Changes this tab's name and icon so it looks like another site. The address bar doesn't change.</p>
      <div class="field"><label for="cloakPreset">Disguise as</label>
        <select id="cloakPreset">
          <option value="none">Off (normal tab)</option>
          <option value="classroom">Google Classroom</option>
          <option value="docs">Google Docs</option>
          <option value="slides">Google Slides</option>
          <option value="drive">Google Drive</option>
          <option value="canvas">Canvas</option>
          <option value="khan">Khan Academy</option>
          <option value="desmos">Desmos</option>
          <option value="wiki">Wikipedia</option>
          <option value="custom">Custom…</option>
        </select></div>
      <div id="cloakCustom" class="opt-sec" style="padding:0;border:0" hidden="">
        <div class="field"><label for="cloakTitle">Tab title</label><input id="cloakTitle" placeholder="e.g. Period 3 notes" autocomplete="off"></div>
        <div class="field"><label for="cloakIcon">Icon image URL</label><input id="cloakIcon" placeholder="https://example.com/favicon.png" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></div>
      </div>
      <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="cloakAway"> Only cloak while I'm on another tab</label>
      <p id="cloakNote" class="cloak-note" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </section>
    <section class="opt-sec"><h3>Reset</h3>
      <p>Puts every option back to its default, including the starting repository.</p>
      <div><button id="resetAll" class="ghost" type="button">Reset all options</button></div>
    </section>
  </div>
</dialog>

<script>
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const statusEl=$('status'),resultsEl=$('results'),searchEl=$('search'),listEl=$('suggest'),filterEl=$('filter'),refreshBtn=$('refresh');
let allSvgs=[],currentRepo='',items=[],active=-1,searchTimer,searchCtrl,searchSeq=0;
const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]));
const store={get(){try{return localStorage.getItem('lastRepo')||''}catch{return ''}},set(v){try{localStorage.setItem('lastRepo',v)}catch{}}};
function setStatus(html,isError){statusEl.className='status'+(isError?' error':'');statusEl.innerHTML=html}
function showEmpty(title,text){resultsEl.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><strong>'+esc(title)+'</strong>'+esc(text)+'</div>'}

/* ---------- Repository search ---------- */
function openList(){listEl.hidden=false;searchEl.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true')}
function closeList(){listEl.hidden=true;searchEl.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');searchEl.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');active=-1}
function fmtStars(n){return n>=1000?(n/1000).toFixed(n>=10000?0:1)+'k stars':n+(n===1?' star':' stars')}
function renderSuggest(){
  listEl.innerHTML=items.map((r,i)=>`<li class="opt" role="option" id="opt-${i}" data-i="${i}" aria-selected="${i===active}"><div class="top"><span class="n">${esc(r.full_name)}</span><span class="m">${fmtStars(r.stargazers_count)}</span></div>${r.description?`<div class="d">${esc(r.description)}</div>`:''}</li>`).join('');
  openList();
}
function showMessage(text,isError){items=[];active=-1;listEl.innerHTML='<li class="msg'+(isError?' error':'')+'">'+esc(text)+'</li>';openList()}
function buildQuery(raw){
  let t=raw.trim().replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?github\.com\//,'').replace(/\.git$/,'').replace(/\/+$/,(m)=>m.length?'/':'');
  if(t.includes('/')){const [owner,...rest]=t.split('/');const name=rest.join('/').trim();
    return owner?(name?name+' in:name user:'+owner:'user:'+owner):name}
  return t+' in:name';
}
async function runSearch(raw){
  const term=raw.trim();
  if(term.replace(/[\/\s]/g,'').length<2){closeList();return}
  const q=buildQuery(term),seq=++searchSeq;
  if(searchCtrl)searchCtrl.abort();searchCtrl=new AbortController();
  showMessage('Searching…');
  try{
    const res=await fetch('https://api.github.com/search/repositories?per_page='+settings.searchCount+'&q='+encodeURIComponent(q),{headers:{'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json'},signal:searchCtrl.signal});
    if(!res.ok)throw new Error(res.status===403||res.status===429?'GitHub is limiting searches right now. Wait a minute and try again.':'GitHub search failed (HTTP '+res.status+').');
    const data=await res.json();
    if(seq!==searchSeq)return;
    items=data.items||[];active=-1;
    if(!items.length){showMessage('No public repositories match “'+term+'”. Try a different name.');return}
    renderSuggest();
  }catch(e){if(e.name==='AbortError')return;if(seq===searchSeq)showMessage(e.message,true)}
}
function choose(i){
  const r=items[i];if(!r)return;
  searchEl.value=r.full_name;closeList();filterEl.value='';
  store.set(r.full_name);scan(r.full_name);
}
function move(delta){
  if(!items.length)return;
  if(listEl.hidden)openList();
  active=(active+delta+items.length)%items.length;
  listEl.querySelectorAll('.opt').forEach((el,i)=>el.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(i===active)));
  const el=$('opt-'+active);searchEl.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant','opt-'+active);el&&el.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
}
searchEl.addEventListener('input',()=>{clearTimeout(searchTimer);if(!settings.searchAsType){items=[];closeList();return}searchTimer=setTimeout(()=>runSearch(searchEl.value),350)});
searchEl.addEventListener('focus',()=>{if(items.length&&searchEl.value.trim())renderSuggest()});
searchEl.addEventListener('blur',()=>setTimeout(closeList,120));
searchEl.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.key==='ArrowDown'){e.preventDefault();move(1)}
  else if(e.key==='ArrowUp'){e.preventDefault();move(-1)}
  else if(e.key==='Escape'){closeList()}
  else if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();clearTimeout(searchTimer);
    if(items.length&&!listEl.hidden)choose(active>=0?active:0);
    else runSearch(searchEl.value)}
});
listEl.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{e.preventDefault();const o=e.target.closest('.opt');if(o)choose(+o.dataset.i)});

/* ---------- SVG listing and folder views ---------- */
let browsePath='',collapsed=new Set();
const dirOf=p=>p.includes('/')?p.slice(0,p.lastIndexOf('/')):'';
const plural=(n,w)=>n+' '+w+(n===1?'':'s');
const FOLDER_ICON='<svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 7a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4l2 2h8a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v8a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z"/></svg>';
function cardHtml(f){
  shown.push(f);const i=shown.length-1,name=f.path.split('/').pop();
  return `<article class="item"><div class="preview"><img loading="lazy" alt="Preview of ${esc(name)}" src="${esc(f.cdn)}"><span class="none" hidden>Preview unavailable</span></div><div class="body"><div><h2>${esc(name)}</h2><p class="path">${esc(f.path)}</p></div><div class="actions"><button type="button" class="copy" data-i="${i}">${COPY_LABEL[settings.copyFormat]}</button><a href="${esc(f.cdn)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open SVG</a><a href="${esc(f.github)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GitHub</a></div></div></article>`;
}
const gridHtml=files=>'<div class="grid">'+files.map(cardHtml).join('')+'</div>';
function syncView(){
  const v=['grouped','browse'].includes(settings.view)?settings.view:'all';
  document.querySelectorAll('.seg-btn').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.view===v)));
}
function renderBrowse(){
  const prefix=browsePath?browsePath+'/':'';
  const inside=allSvgs.filter(f=>f.path.startsWith(prefix));
  if(!inside.length&&browsePath){browsePath='';renderBrowse();return}
  const direct=[],subs=new Map();
  inside.forEach(f=>{const rest=f.path.slice(prefix.length),k=rest.indexOf('/');
    if(k<0)direct.push(f);else{const n=rest.slice(0,k);subs.set(n,(subs.get(n)||0)+1)}});
  const names=[...subs.keys()].sort((x,y)=>x.localeCompare(y));
  if(settings.sort==='path-desc')names.reverse();
  const parts=browsePath?browsePath.split('/'):[],repoName=allSvgs.repo.split('/')[1]||allSvgs.repo;
  let crumbs=parts.length?`<button type="button" class="crumb" data-path="">${esc(repoName)}</button>`:`<strong>${esc(repoName)}</strong>`;
  parts.forEach((part,i)=>{const path=parts.slice(0,i+1).join('/');
    crumbs+='<span class="sep">/</span>'+(i===parts.length-1?`<strong aria-current="page">${esc(part)}</strong>`:`<button type="button" class="crumb" data-path="${esc(path)}">${esc(part)}</button>`)});
  setStatus(`<span>Browsing <strong>${esc(allSvgs.repo+(browsePath?'/'+browsePath:''))}</strong>: ${plural(direct.length,'SVG')} here, ${plural(names.length,'subfolder')}</span><span>Branch: ${esc(allSvgs.branch)}</span>`);
  resultsEl.innerHTML=`<nav class="crumbs" aria-label="Folder path">${crumbs}</nav>`
    +(names.length?'<div class="folders">'+names.map(n=>`<button type="button" class="folder" data-path="${esc(prefix+n)}"><span class="ficon">${FOLDER_ICON}</span><span><span class="fname">${esc(n)}</span><span class="fcount">${plural(subs.get(n),'SVG')}</span></span></button>`).join('')+'</div>':'')
    +(direct.length?gridHtml(sortFiles(direct)):'');
}
function render(){
  shown=[];
  const q=filterEl.value.trim().toLowerCase(),view=['grouped','browse'].includes(settings.view)?settings.view:'all';
  $('groupTools').hidden=view!=='grouped';
  const matches=sortFiles(allSvgs.filter(f=>f.path.toLowerCase().includes(q)));
  const repoB='<strong>'+esc(allSvgs.repo)+'</strong>',branch='<span>Branch: '+esc(allSvgs.branch)+'</span>';
  if(!matches.length){
    setStatus(`<span>Showing <strong>0</strong> of ${plural(allSvgs.length,'SVG')} in ${repoB}</span>${branch}`);
    showEmpty(allSvgs.length?'No SVGs match that filter':'No SVGs found',allSvgs.length?'Clear the filter to see all files.':'This repository has no .svg files on its default branch.');return}
  if(view==='browse'&&!q){renderBrowse();return}
  if(view==='grouped'){
    const groups=new Map();
    matches.forEach(f=>{const d=dirOf(f.path);if(!groups.has(d))groups.set(d,[]);groups.get(d).push(f)});
    const dirs=[...groups.keys()].sort((x,y)=>x.localeCompare(y));
    if(settings.sort==='path-desc')dirs.reverse();
    setStatus(`<span>Showing <strong>${matches.length}</strong> of ${plural(allSvgs.length,'SVG')} in ${plural(dirs.length,'folder')} of ${repoB}</span>${branch}`);
    resultsEl.innerHTML=dirs.map(d=>`<details class="group" data-dir="${esc(d)}"${collapsed.has(d)?'':' open'}><summary><span class="gname">${d?esc(d):'Repository root'}</span><span class="gcount">${plural(groups.get(d).length,'SVG')}</span></summary>${gridHtml(groups.get(d))}</details>`).join('');
    resultsEl.querySelectorAll('.group').forEach(g=>g.addEventListener('toggle',()=>{if(g.open)collapsed.delete(g.dataset.dir);else collapsed.add(g.dataset.dir)}));
    return;
  }
  setStatus(view==='browse'
    ?`<span>Searching all folders: <strong>${matches.length}</strong> match${matches.length===1?'':'es'} in ${repoB}</span>${branch}`
    :`<span>Showing <strong>${matches.length}</strong> of ${plural(allSvgs.length,'SVG')} in ${repoB}</span>${branch}`);
  resultsEl.innerHTML=gridHtml(matches);
}
resultsEl.addEventListener('error',e=>{
  const img=e.target,box=img.closest&&img.closest('.preview');
  if(img.tagName==='IMG'&&box){img.remove();const n=box.querySelector('.none');if(n)n.hidden=false}
},true);
resultsEl.addEventListener('click',async e=>{
  const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;
  if(b.classList.contains('copy')){
    const f=shown[+b.dataset.i];if(!f)return;
    try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(copyText(f));b.textContent='Copied';b.classList.add('done');setTimeout(()=>{b.textContent=COPY_LABEL[settings.copyFormat];b.classList.remove('done')},1600)}
    catch{prompt('Copy this URL:',copyText(f))}
  }else if(b.classList.contains('folder')||b.classList.contains('crumb')){
    browsePath=b.dataset.path;render();
    const first=resultsEl.querySelector('.crumbs button, .crumbs strong');if(first)first.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
  }
});
document.querySelectorAll('.seg-btn').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{settings.view=b.dataset.view;saveSettings();syncView();if(allSvgs.length)render()}));
$('expandAll').addEventListener('click',()=>{collapsed.clear();render()});
$('collapseAll').addEventListener('click',()=>{collapsed=new Set(allSvgs.map(f=>dirOf(f.path)));render()});
async function scan(raw){
  currentRepo=raw;refreshBtn.disabled=true;
  setStatus('Scanning <strong>'+esc(raw)+'</strong>…');
  resultsEl.innerHTML='<div class="grid">'+'<div class="skeleton"></div>'.repeat(6)+'</div>';allSvgs=[];browsePath='';collapsed=new Set();
  try{
    const headers={'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json'};
    const infoRes=await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/'+raw,{headers,cache:'no-store'});
    if(!infoRes.ok)throw new Error(infoRes.status===404?'Repository not found, or it is private.':infoRes.status===403?'GitHub rate limit reached. Try again in a few minutes.':'GitHub returned HTTP '+infoRes.status+'.');
    const branch=(await infoRes.json()).default_branch;
    if(!branch)throw new Error('Could not determine the default branch.');
    const treeRes=await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/'+raw+'/git/trees/'+encodeURIComponent(branch)+'?recursive=1',{headers,cache:'no-store'});
    if(!treeRes.ok)throw new Error(treeRes.status===403?'GitHub rate limit reached. Try again in a few minutes.':'Could not read the file list (HTTP '+treeRes.status+').');
    const tree=await treeRes.json();
    allSvgs=(tree.tree||[]).filter(x=>x.type==='blob'&&/\.svg$/i.test(x.path)).map(x=>{const p=x.path.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/');return{path:x.path,cdn:'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/'+raw+'@'+branch+'/'+p,github:'https://github.com/'+raw+'/blob/'+branch+'/'+p,raw:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/'+raw+'/'+branch+'/'+p}}).sort((a,b)=>a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
    allSvgs.repo=raw;allSvgs.branch=branch;
    render();
    if(tree.truncated)statusEl.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span>GitHub truncated this large repository, so some SVGs may be missing.</span>');
  }catch(e){
    setStatus('Scan failed: '+esc(e.message),true);
    showEmpty('Nothing to show','Check your connection and that the repository is public, then press Rescan.');
  }finally{refreshBtn.disabled=false}
}
refreshBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(currentRepo)scan(currentRepo)});
filterEl.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(allSvgs.length)render()});

/* ---------- Tab cloak ---------- */
const DEFAULT_TITLE=document.title,DEFAULT_ICON=document.getElementById('favicon').getAttribute('href');
const favUrl=d=>'https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain='+encodeURIComponent(d)+'&sz=64';
const CLOAKS={
  classroom:{title:'Classes',domain:'classroom.google.com'},
  docs:{title:'Untitled document - Google Docs',domain:'docs.google.com'},
  slides:{title:'Untitled presentation - Google Slides',domain:'slides.google.com'},
  drive:{title:'My Drive - Google Drive',domain:'drive.google.com'},
  canvas:{title:'Dashboard',domain:'instructure.com'},
  khan:{title:'Khan Academy',domain:'khanacademy.org'},
  desmos:{title:'Desmos | Graphing Calculator',domain:'desmos.com'},
  wiki:{title:'Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia',domain:'wikipedia.org'}
};
const cloakEls={preset:$('cloakPreset'),custom:$('cloakCustom'),title:$('cloakTitle'),icon:$('cloakIcon'),away:$('cloakAway'),note:$('cloakNote')};
let cloak={preset:'none',title:'',icon:'',away:false};
try{Object.assign(cloak,JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cloak')||'{}'))}catch{}
if(cloak.preset!=='none'&&cloak.preset!=='custom'&&!CLOAKS[cloak.preset])cloak.preset='none';
const saveCloak=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('cloak',JSON.stringify(cloak))}catch{}};
function cloakLook(){
  if(cloak.preset==='custom')return{title:cloak.title.trim()||DEFAULT_TITLE,icon:cloak.icon.trim()||DEFAULT_ICON};
  const c=CLOAKS[cloak.preset];return c?{title:c.title,icon:favUrl(c.domain)}:null;
}
function setIcon(href){
  document.querySelectorAll('link[rel~="icon"]').forEach(l=>l.remove());
  const l=document.createElement('link');l.id='favicon';l.rel='icon';l.href=href;document.head.appendChild(l);
}
function applyLook(){
  const look=cloakLook(),on=!!look&&(!cloak.away||document.hidden);
  document.title=on?look.title:DEFAULT_TITLE;
  setIcon(on?look.icon:DEFAULT_ICON);
}
function syncCloakUI(){
  cloakEls.preset.value=cloak.preset;cloakEls.title.value=cloak.title;cloakEls.icon.value=cloak.icon;cloakEls.away.checked=cloak.away;
  cloakEls.custom.hidden=cloak.preset!=='custom';
  const look=cloakLook();
  cloakEls.note.textContent=!look?'Tab cloak is off.':cloak.away?'While you are on another tab, it will show “'+look.title+'”.':'This tab now shows “'+look.title+'”.';
}
function updateCloak(){saveCloak();syncCloakUI();applyLook()}
cloakEls.preset.addEventListener('change',()=>{cloak.preset=cloakEls.preset.value;updateCloak()});
cloakEls.title.addEventListener('input',()=>{cloak.title=cloakEls.title.value;updateCloak()});
cloakEls.icon.addEventListener('change',()=>{cloak.icon=cloakEls.icon.value;updateCloak()});
cloakEls.away.addEventListener('change',()=>{cloak.away=cloakEls.away.checked;updateCloak()});
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',applyLook);
syncCloakUI();applyLook();

/* ---------- Options ---------- */
const DEFAULTS={accent:'#22d3ee',tint:true,density:'medium',previewBg:'checker',showPreviews:true,showPath:true,sort:'path-asc',copyFormat:'jsdelivr',openLast:false,startRepo:'braydensrandomcreations/StudyPortalXRT',searchAsType:true,searchCount:8,view:'all'};
let settings=Object.assign({},DEFAULTS);
try{Object.assign(settings,JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('settings')||'{}'))}catch{}
const saveSettings=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('settings',JSON.stringify(settings))}catch{}};
const COPY_LABEL={jsdelivr:'Copy URL',raw:'Copy raw URL',markdown:'Copy Markdown',html:'Copy HTML'};
const DENSITY={small:['200px','110px'],medium:['250px','140px'],large:['340px','200px']};
const SWATCHES=[['Cyan','#22d3ee'],['Blue','#60a5fa'],['Violet','#a78bfa'],['Pink','#f472b6'],['Red','#f87171'],['Orange','#fb923c'],['Yellow','#facc15'],['Green','#4ade80']];
let shown=[];
function copyText(f){
  const name=f.path.split('/').pop();
  if(settings.copyFormat==='raw')return f.raw;
  if(settings.copyFormat==='markdown')return '!['+name+']('+f.cdn+')';
  if(settings.copyFormat==='html')return '<img src="'+f.cdn+'" alt="'+name.replace(/"/g,'"')+'">';
  return f.cdn;
}
function sortFiles(a){
  const n=f=>f.path.split('/').pop().toLowerCase(),c=[...a];
  if(settings.sort==='path-desc')c.sort((x,y)=>y.path.localeCompare(x.path));
  else if(settings.sort==='name-asc')c.sort((x,y)=>n(x).localeCompare(n(y)));
  else c.sort((x,y)=>x.path.localeCompare(y.path));
  return c;
}
function hexToHsl(hex){
  const m=/^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(hex),n=m?parseInt(m[1],16):0x22d3ee;
  const r=(n>>16&255)/255,g=(n>>8&255)/255,b=(n&255)/255,mx=Math.max(r,g,b),mn=Math.min(r,g,b),d=mx-mn,l=(mx+mn)/2;
  let h=0,s=0;
  if(d){s=d/(1-Math.abs(2*l-1));h=mx===r?((g-b)/d)%6:mx===g?(b-r)/d+2:(r-g)/d+4;h=Math.round((h*60+360)%360)}
  const lin=v=>v<=.03928?v/12.92:Math.pow((v+.055)/1.055,2.4);
  return{h,s:Math.round(s*100),l:Math.round(l*100),lum:.2126*lin(r)+.7152*lin(g)+.0722*lin(b)};
}
const hsl=(h,s,l)=>'hsl('+h+' '+Math.round(s)+'% '+l+'%)';
function applyTheme(){
  const{h,s,l,lum}=hexToHsl(settings.accent),t=settings.tint?1:.1,st=document.documentElement.style,set=(k,v)=>st.setProperty(k,v);
  set('--accent',settings.accent);
  set('--accent-hi',hsl(h,Math.max(s,55),Math.min(80,Math.max(l+12,62))));
  set('--on-accent',lum>.3?hsl(h,60,7):'#ffffff');
  set('--bg',hsl(h,40*t,6));set('--surface',hsl(h,35*t,9));set('--raised',hsl(h,32*t,12));
  set('--line',hsl(h,38*t,22));set('--line-soft',hsl(h,35*t,16));set('--line-hover',hsl(h,38*t,30));
  set('--input',hsl(h,40*t,5));set('--glow',hsl(h,60*t,15));set('--check1',hsl(h,35*t,8));set('--check2',hsl(h,35*t,11));
  set('--muted',hsl(h,25*t,68));set('--placeholder',hsl(h,22*t,45));set('--text',hsl(h,80*t,93));
}
function applySettings(){
  applyTheme();
  const d=DENSITY[settings.density]||DENSITY.medium,st=document.documentElement.style;
  st.setProperty('--card-min',d[0]);st.setProperty('--prev-h',d[1]);
  document.body.dataset.pbg=settings.previewBg;
  document.body.classList.toggle('no-previews',!settings.showPreviews);
  document.body.classList.toggle('no-path',!settings.showPath);
}
const optBind=[['optDensity','density'],['optPreviewBg','previewBg'],['optSort','sort'],['optCopy','copyFormat'],['optCount','searchCount','num'],['optTint','tint','bool'],['optShowPreviews','showPreviews','bool'],['optShowPath','showPath','bool'],['optRemember','openLast','bool'],['optStart','startRepo'],['optAsType','searchAsType','bool']];
function syncSettingsUI(){syncView();
  optBind.forEach(([id,key,type])=>{const el=$(id);if(type==='bool')el.checked=!!settings[key];else el.value=String(settings[key])});
  $('accentPicker').value=/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(settings.accent)?settings.accent:DEFAULTS.accent;
  document.querySelectorAll('.sw').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.color===settings.accent.toLowerCase())));
}
function changed(rerender){saveSettings();syncSettingsUI();applySettings();if(rerender&&allSvgs.length)render()}
$('swatches').innerHTML=SWATCHES.map(([n,c])=>'<button type="button" class="sw" data-color="'+c+'" style="background:'+c+'" title="'+n+'" aria-label="'+n+'" aria-pressed="false"></button>').join('');
$('swatches').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('.sw');if(b){settings.accent=b.dataset.color;changed(false)}});
$('accentPicker').addEventListener('input',e=>{settings.accent=e.target.value;changed(false)});
optBind.forEach(([id,key,type])=>$(id).addEventListener('change',e=>{
  const el=e.target;settings[key]=type==='bool'?el.checked:type==='num'?+el.value:el.value;
  if(key==='startRepo'){
    const v=el.value.trim().replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?github\.com\//i,'').replace(/\.git$/,'').replace(/\/+$/,'');
    settings.startRepo=/^[^\/\s]+\/[^\/\s]+$/.test(v)?v:DEFAULTS.startRepo;
  }
  changed(true);
}));
$('resetAll').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(!confirm('Reset every option to its default?'))return;
  settings=Object.assign({},DEFAULTS);cloak={preset:'none',title:'',icon:'',away:false};
  try{localStorage.removeItem('lastRepo')}catch{}
  saveCloak();syncCloakUI();applyLook();changed(true);
});
const dlg=$('options');
$('openOptions').addEventListener('click',()=>dlg.showModal());
$('closeOptions').addEventListener('click',()=>dlg.close());
dlg.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===dlg)dlg.close()});
syncSettingsUI();applySettings();

/* ---------- Random tip ---------- */
const TIPS=[
  "Got a unblocked JsDelivr site? Copy the repo and user to potentially get lots of links!",
  "Type a username followed by a slash, like OrangeesDev/, to browse all of that user’s repositories.",
  "Use the arrow keys and Enter to pick a repository from the search results.",
  "Use the filter box to narrow the results by filename.",
  "Can’t see an SVG in its preview? Set the preview background to solid light in Options.",
  "Want Markdown or HTML instead of a plain link? Change what the copy button copies in Options.",
  "If jsDelivr is blocked on your network, try the GitHub raw URL copy option in Options. It might work.",
  "Tab cloak in Options makes this tab look like Google Classroom, Docs, Canvas and more.",
  "Turn on “Only cloak while I’m on another tab” so the tab looks normal while you’re using it.",
  "Pick any accent color in Options and the whole page changes to match.",
  "Hit GitHub’s search limit? Turn off “Search as I type” in Options and press Enter to search.",
  "Turn off previews in Options for a compact list that loads faster.",
  "Add new files to a repository? Press Rescan to pick them up.",
  "Change the repository this page opens on in Options, or have it reopen the last one you viewed.",
  "Use the card size setting in Options to fit more SVGs on screen."
];
(function(){
  let last=-1;try{const v=localStorage.getItem('lastTip');last=v===null?-1:+v}catch{}
  let i=Math.floor(Math.random()*TIPS.length);
  if(TIPS.length>1&&i===last)i=(i+1+Math.floor(Math.random()*(TIPS.length-1)))%TIPS.length;
  try{localStorage.setItem('lastTip',String(i))}catch{}
  $('tipText').textContent=TIPS[i];
})();

/* ---------- Start ---------- */
const first=(settings.openLast&&store.get())||settings.startRepo||DEFAULTS.startRepo;
searchEl.value=first;scan(first);
</script>
